# Positive control for the clean-consumer fixture, and the liveness probe that
# makes its sibling's clean verdicts mean anything.
#
# Two jobs, both about keeping the minimal consumer's result honest:
#
#   1. Consume the installed SDK the ordinary way. If this cannot configure,
#      link and run, the staging harness is broken and the minimal consumer's
#      failure is not evidence of anything.
#
#   2. Report which exclusion groups are REALIZABLE in this SDK at all. A
#      dependency that was never installed cannot appear on anybody's link
#      line, so "the minimal consumer does not link Skia" is only a finding
#      when a Skia target exists here to have been linked. Measuring that from
#      the full consumer rather than the minimal one is deliberate: this is the
#      project that is allowed to see the whole SDK.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(PulpCleanConsumerFull VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

if(NOT DEFINED PULP_CLEAN_CONSUMER_POLICY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "PULP_CLEAN_CONSUMER_POLICY must point at exclusion_policy.cmake")
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED PULP_CLEAN_CONSUMER_LIVENESS_REPORT)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "PULP_CLEAN_CONSUMER_LIVENESS_REPORT must name the output file")
endif()

find_package(Pulp CONFIG REQUIRED)

add_executable(pulp-clean-consumer-full main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(pulp-clean-consumer-full PRIVATE Pulp::audio Pulp::state)

# ── Liveness ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

include("${PULP_CLEAN_CONSUMER_POLICY}")

set(_report "# Generated by the clean-consumer fixture. Do not edit.\n")
set(_realizable "")
set(_absent "")

foreach(_group IN LISTS PULP_CLEAN_CONSUMER_GROUPS)
    set(_present "")
    foreach(_candidate IN LISTS PULP_CLEAN_CONSUMER_REALIZED_BY_${_group})
        if(TARGET "${_candidate}")
            list(APPEND _present "${_candidate}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(_present)
        list(APPEND _realizable "${_group}")
        string(APPEND _report
            "set(PULP_CLEAN_CONSUMER_REALIZABLE_${_group} ${_present})\n")
    else()
        list(APPEND _absent "${_group}")
    endif()
endforeach()

string(APPEND _report
    "set(PULP_CLEAN_CONSUMER_REALIZABLE_GROUPS ${_realizable})\n")
string(APPEND _report
    "set(PULP_CLEAN_CONSUMER_ABSENT_GROUPS ${_absent})\n")
file(WRITE "${PULP_CLEAN_CONSUMER_LIVENESS_REPORT}" "${_report}")

message(STATUS "clean-consumer: SDK can realize [${_realizable}]")
if(_absent)
    message(STATUS
        "clean-consumer: SDK cannot realize [${_absent}]"
        " (exclusions for these are vacuous in this configuration)")
endif()
